text: 女子仍然阴郁愤怒。诺曼建议为了她的安全把她绑起来。西尔维娅瞪他一眼让他闭嘴，并拿出你们的一些食物给女子。
夜深时，诺曼守夜，你被人摇醒。“对不起，教授。那女孩不见了。我不到五分钟前才去看过她。她肯定一点声音都没发出来。”
你们不可能在夜里截住一个熟悉当地地形的人，也不大可能再次找到那片空地。你耸耸肩，回去睡觉。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 580
text: The woman remains sullen and angry. Norman suggests tying her up for her own safety. Sylvia silences him with a glare and offers the woman some of your food.
You are shaken awake in the small hours during Norman’s watch. “I’m sorry, Professor. The girl’s gone. I checked on her not five minutes ago. She must have been absolutely silent.”
You are not going to intercept a stealthy local in the woods at night. And it’s unlikely you could find that clearing again. You shrug and go back to sleep.
